notes: SBLGNT.LUK.21.1.v001 is underdetermined and the projection carries r00-base; both readings are compatible with the ASV's wording, so no rule 97 question arises.
The ASV's marginal alternative rendering (and they were rich) would restructure the clause; the text rendering is aligned here.

τοὺς governs a participle but the ASV writes it a determiner and a supplied nominal rather than a pronoun, so rule 22's supplied-nominal clause (with rules 49 and 102) gives it the men headed on men, and βάλλοντας keeps that were casting.
